text: Hey, my husband is also British.  We did just upgrade to a5 and got the same request few times now. I showed them the letter from the UK which states they dont register it as we also got married in cyprus.  And they said its a must for completing the procedure and we better get it ASAP. But each clerk i show the letter to just says they'll look into it and let me know in future . Seems they're not sure themselves yet. Maybe will have to get a statuary declaration instead in future is what I understood .but for now it waits.
